falsifier: Author a rule that closes a MEASURED datum transposition -- one that `wf_ordered_datum_screen.py` reports as a DATUM-SWAP row -- using only copy_register_fields, in any mode including value_equality_recolor, and show `ws_datum_tier_audit.py` returning OK rather than MISMATCH for it after a full link. Equivalently, exhibit a DATUM-SWAP row whose two words differ in a register field, which would mean the transposition is reachable by a renaming after all. Conversely, exhibit a permutation window whose before_relocations_sha256 and after_relocations_sha256 are EQUAL while the window's relocations demonstrably moved, which would break the mechanical proof this law rests on.
subject: tool:webfrank
value:
WHEN TWO POOLED CONSTANTS ARE TRANSPOSED BETWEEN THE TWO STREAMS, THE CURE IS THE `instruction_permutation` STAGE AND IT IS NOT ANY `copy_register_fields` MODE, INCLUDING `value_equality_recolor`. This is the constructive complement of claim.law.CQ_copy-register-fields-can-rotate-constant-load-homes-without-their-relocations.20260903.v1, which established the DEFECT (a recolor rewrites register fields and leaves relocations where they are, so a renaming that rotates two constants' homes binds each register to the wrong datum, and the byte claim fails at LINK time while every gate reads green). CQ's own customer record then prescribed the wrong cure -- attempt.EN_movelogic00-...20260904.v1 said the rule 'must be authored in the VALUE-EQUALITY mode ... never the plain copy_register_fields' -- and that prescription is REFUTED here, on CQ's own function.

WHY NO RECOLOR MODE CAN REACH IT. A transposition's signature is a word whose REGISTER FIELD IS ALREADY CORRECT. Measured on game/enemy/enemy::move_logic00 at 12b0777e5, `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_ordered_datum_screen.py --unit game/enemy/enemy --function move_logic00` printed `DEFECT ... 1 DATUM-SWAP row(s)` and listed `[18] DATUM-SWAP T@lfd f30,0(0) lbl_80346840 (B:400921fb54524550)  O@lfd f30,0(0) @689 (B:401921fb54524550)` -- the SAME register f30 on both sides, under the same mnemonic, at the same position, holding pi in the target and 2*pi in ours. There is no register substitution that fixes that word, because nothing about the register is wrong; what is wrong is which relocation sits at that index. A recolor can only fake it by mapping one raw register to two different registers at its definition and its use, which is exactly the broken bijection CQ caught.

WHY THE PERMUTATION STAGE DOES REACH IT. `permute_instruction_atoms` moves whole atoms and `verify_relocation_binding` requires each window's relocations to stay bound to the atoms they patch, so the relocations travel WITH the words. The mechanical proof that they moved is that the window's `before_relocations_sha256` and `after_relocations_sha256` DIFFER -- on the shipped move_logic00 window they are 3de33386... and 7eeff44c... A recolor-only rule has no relocation hashes at all, which is the schema-level statement of the same fact.

THE WINDOW IS OFTEN WIDER THAN THE TRANSPOSED PAIR, and getting this wrong is the trap. On move_logic00 the two pooled f64 loads at +0x1dc/+0x1e4 are INTERLEAVED with two counter initialisations at +0x1e0/+0x1e8 that are transposed with each other, so the correct window is the four-atom [0x1dc,0x1ec) with order [2,3,0,1]. The tempting two-atom window that swaps only the constants leaves the `li` pair crossed and the recolor then refuses one instruction later, at +0x204.

THE SCREEN THAT DECIDES THIS, and the one that does NOT. `wf_word_diff.py` reported `RELOC-SYMBOL MISMATCH = 0` for move_logic00 both before and after, and `DECODE: REGFIELD-ONLY 53` throughout: it CANNOT see a transposition between an anonymous @N pool entry and a named lbl_ symbol, because it compares names and ours have none. A residual whose family is pool-order is therefore decided by `wf_ordered_datum_screen.py` (order) and `ws_datum_tier_audit.py` (linked binding), never by the word diff's decode line, however clean that line reads.

EVIDENCE, run 54: the retracted recolor-only shape was replayed through the real apply_patch and REFUSED verbatim -- `move_logic00: register-field patch is not a consistent recolor (+0x204: use of g28 does not correspond to g29 under the running renaming); model the residual as an instruction_permutation, declare a proved "value_equality_recolor", or record a manual equivalence audit in "unproven_recolor_audit"` -- and the guard's FIRST suggested option is the correct one. With the permutation added, `wr_try_rule.py` returned BYTE-EQUAL with the datum screen at FULL strength; the ordered-datum screen flipped DEFECT -> BENIGN; and `ws_datum_tier_audit.py --unit game/enemy/enemy` reported 0 MISMATCH. The same composition closed a second function in the same TU the same run (move_logic22, a two-atom ADDR16_LO/EMB_SDA21 transposition at [0x164,0x16c) order [1,0]), so the shape is not unique to the pi/2pi pair.

SCOPE AND CEILING: this does not widen any class. The permutation stage is already sanctioned and already audited for pairwise independence, absence of stores and control ops, and relocation-preserving bijection; this law only says which residuals belong to it. A transposition that cannot be expressed as a permutation of independent straight-line atoms is still outside every class and belongs to source.
